title: Missing tx_queue_destroy() causes linker error
description:
Function tx_queue_destroy() is declared in tx_queue.h (line 231) and called in production code (lora_l2.c:603) and tests (tests/tx_queue/main.c:488), but no implementation exists in tx_queue.c. This causes a linker error: 'Undefined symbols for architecture arm64: _tx_queue_destroy'. The test suite cannot build.

File: lichen/subsys/lichen/link/tx_queue.c
Line: 447
close_reason: Added tx_queue_destroy() implementation that destroys pthread mutex on POSIX and is no-op on Zephyr. Build and all 19 tests pass.
